item.title: Phinks announced for Hunter x Hunter Nen Impact in new trailer, launches next week
item.description: <p>Hunter x Hunter Nen Impact may be the most overlooked fighting game of the year, but it's still trucking along with new DLC characters.</p> <p>Arc System Works and Bushiroad Games have announced that Phinks is the next character coming to Hunter x Hunter Nen Impact, and he'll be here next week.</p>

item.title: SNK World Championship 2026 details revealed with $4.1 million prize pool and new tournament structure that rewards all ranking players
item.description: <p>The fighting game event with the largest prize pool ever recently went down with the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/oct/30/snk-world-championship-2025-results/">SNK World Championship 2025</a>, and they're looking to go big again next year.</p> <p>SNK has now revealed the plans for their 2026 pro circuit including four different titles and tons of tournaments all across the world.</p>

item.title: Invincible VS Producer shares end-of-year update on direction and improvements for the game, Collector's Edition revealed
item.description: <p>2026 is shaping up to hopefully be a big year for fighting games, and Invincible VS is going to be a piece of that pie.</p> <p>The game's Executive Producer, Mike Willette, has now shared an end-of-year update for Invincible VS to talk about its direction and what they're working on.</p>
